summary: Tested 100k-scaling (one-trip answers, cross-server push, cross-server spectators, inbox poll_s, load counters) and Cheer Squad diamond buying. Requested suites run with a second 3-worker backend on :8002 (RF_NODE_B): iter74 4/4, iter73 4 + 1 skipped (Cup Night doors-hour only), phase3 7/7, iter69 4/4 -> 19 passed, 1 skipped. New independent suite tests/test_iter75_review.py: 8/9 passed. One minor backend bug: POST /api/rf/squads/buy charges diamonds for a squad already opened by cup wins. Frontend (390 and 320 wide, QA learner 9R/4B/1E/0G, 2 cups): every squads-screen check matched the request. Golden Glam buy is enabled with no shortfall note. Royal shows squad-squad_royal-short NEED 2 more Blue + 1 more Emerald, and its button is disabled. Legend shows NEED 2 more Emerald + 2 more Gold, also disabled. The buy sheet opens with no squad-buy-short, the confirm button is enabled and Not now closes it. Tapping the disabled Royal button opens nothing. No horizontal overflow at 320. Regression passed: lobby, the Store tab's Cheer Squads card opens /rapid/squads, and a Practice Rival match took 4 answers (all 200, the rival's live score moved 0->3). Leaving the match ends it as a forfeit and returns to /rapid, and ws_nodes was emptied. Inbox polling measured about 1 call per 9 s outside a match and none faster inside it. The QA wallet is unchanged (9/4/1, 188 coins) and nothing was bought. No deprecated Expo packages were found (expo-audio is used; no expo-av).

minor.issue: A squad already opened by cup wins (cups_won >= wins, not in owned) can still be bought, and diamonds are deducted (reproduced: cups_won=3, buy squad_gold -> 200 and red 9->1). The UI hides the button, but a race (a cup is won while the sheet is open) or a direct API call wastes diamonds. Fix: add a filter so cups_won < s['wins'] (or return 409 'Already opened by cup wins'). squads.py:57-60
The body is a raw dict, not a Pydantic model (works, but there is no schema validation; an empty or unknown id correctly gives 404).
Anyone can call it without auth, and it returns pid and open_files_limit. Consider limiting it to internal callers or removing pid.

issues: PriceButton height is 42 (squad-*-buy), below the 44pt touch-target minimum
ShortNote accessibilityLabel reads awkwardly: 'Need 2 Blue + 1 Emerald more diamonds'. Suggest 'Need 2 more Blue and 1 more Emerald diamonds'
The 'NEED' label is 11px muted text on a dark panel, so contrast is low

action_items: squads.py buy(): reject squads already unlocked by cup wins (add a cups_won < wins condition to the find_one_and_update filter, else 409), so no diamonds are spent for nothing
Optional: make PriceButton at least 44 high; reword the ShortNote accessibility label; use a Pydantic model for the squads buy/equip body
critical_code_review_comments: quick_answer keeps the same guards as the full path (status, ends_at, order via $size, forfeit). Server-measured ms is clamped to 0..16000. Replays and out-of-order answers fall back to the full path, which is correct. Negative index and index 30 are blocked by DuelAnswer (422).
rf_events tailable cursor stays alive with no matching events (checked on the live 74k-doc capped collection), so idle servers do not re-scan it.

ws_nodes uses a per-process uuid. If a server dies without closing its sockets, its node id stays in live matches' ws_nodes, and events keep being addressed to the dead node until the match ends. That is harmless but wasteful; consider a TTL or a heartbeat-based cleanup.

InboxPoller uses a setTimeout chain: max(poll_s, 25 when playing else 8) with ±1 s jitter. It follows poll_s at each reschedule. When the app comes back to the foreground, no refresh happens until the next tick (up to 8 s).
seed_data_creation: Only TEST-rv75-* grants/profiles/duels/rf_watch rows were created by the test file and removed by its fixture (verified 0 left). One real Practice Rival match was played and forfeited on the QA account, as the request asked. No purchase was made and the QA wallet is unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Starting the :8002 backend with plain nohup inside a tool call hangs the call and gets killed when it times out. Use `setsid nohup ... < /dev/null & disown` (the call still timed out, but the process survived), then pkill -f 'port 8002' afterwards. Login in Playwright: click the inputs and use keyboard.type (page.fill on entry-phone-input did not stick). The QA pid is PF37CC308 (rf_profiles.pid). Ignore the pre-existing 401 on /api/jl/auth/refresh that comes before login.
